mapper.select: select dm.discount_id, dm.discount_type_id, dt.discount_type_name, dm.status, dm.discount_title, dm.discount_rate, dm.threshold_amount, dm.reduction_amount, dm.booking_time, dm.advance_days, dm.start_date, dm.end_date from discount_master dm INNER JOIN discount_type_master dt ON dm.discount_type_id = dt.discount_type_id where discount_scope = 1

select dm.discount_id, dm.discount_type_id, dt.discount_type_name, dm.status, dm.discount_title, dm.discount_rate, dm.threshold_amount, dm.reduction_amount, dm.booking_time, dm.advance_days, dm.start_date, dm.end_date from discount_master dm INNER JOIN discount_type_master dt ON dm.discount_type_id = dt.discount_type_id where dm.discount_id = #{discount_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO discount_master (discount_scope, discount_type_id, status, discount_title, discount_rate, threshold_amount, reduction_amount, booking_time, advance_days, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{discount_scope}, #{discountType.discount_type_id}, #{status}, #{discount_title}, #{discount_rate}, #{threshold_amount}, #{reduction_amount}, #{booking_time}, #{advance_days}, #{start_date}, #{end_date})
